name: SCU Access27 international tuition fee
summary: Reduced flat 2027 annual tuition fee of $27,000 for most SCU courses, offered automatically to all international students.
key: Annual international tuition for most courses is set at an accessible $27,000 in 2027.
who: All international students, on student or non-student visas, at all SCU and The Hotel School campuses
how: No application: you are automatically offered the Access27 fee when you apply
catches: Excludes Master of Nursing, veterinary degrees, Study Abroad, English language programs, research degrees, non-award and offshore courses
Based on a full-time load of 8 units; fewer units charged pro-rata

evidence.quote: Yes, this will apply to all international students.
